name: HoloMoves: Block Ball
summary: Block Ball is an immersive and dynamic exergame designed to support rehabilitation and physical therapy through engaging movement-based gameplay. Drawing inspiration from classic tennis mechanics, Block Ball challenges players to stay active as they move side-to-side to hit a fast-moving ball using a virtual block. Whether playing in competitive mode against an opponent or in solo endurance mode to beat their personal high score, players are constantly encouraged to improve their mobility and reaction time.
